cd /app/submission && cat > /workspace/tmp/t11.py << 'PY'
import subprocess, json, sys
def run(obj):
    p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','/app/submission/entry.py'],input=json.dumps(obj).encode(),capture_output=True)
    try: return json.loads(p.stdout.decode())
    except: return {'_raw':p.stdout.decode(),'_err':p.stderr.decode()}
def cfg(**kw):
    base=dict(early=False,overlap="reject",buffer_packets=8,idle_ms=0,
              max_streams_bidi=100,max_streams_uni=100,max_stream_data=65536,
              max_data=1000000000,crypto_limit=65536,sent={"I":[],"H":[[0,10]],"A":[]})
    base.update(kw); return base
def req(traces): return {"version":1,"traces":traces}
def tr(tid,config,events): return {"id":tid,"config":config,"events":events}
def P(level,pn,frames,auth=True): return {"level":level,"pn":pn,"auth":auth,"frames":frames}
def D(t,bytes,packets): return {"t":t,"op":"datagram","bytes":bytes,"packets":packets}
# H ack valid
print("h_ack", json.dumps(run(req([tr("a",cfg(),[D(0,1200,[P("H",0,[{"type":"ACK","ranges":[[2,4]]}])])])]))['results'][0]['packets']))
# STOP creates entry
r=run(req([tr("a",cfg(),[
  {"t":0,"op":"key","level":"A","action":"install"},
  D(1,1200,[P("A",0,[{"type":"STOP_SENDING","id":0},{"type":"STREAM","id":8,"offset":0,"data_hex":"aa","fin":False}])]),
])]))
print("stop_entry", json.dumps(r['results'][0]['streams']))
# crypto reorder contiguous at H
r=run(req([tr("a",cfg(early=False),[
  D(0,1200,[P("H",0,[{"type":"CRYPTO","offset":2,"data_hex":"0304"}])])]),]) if False else None
# do with key H installed at t0 then crypto out of order
r=run(req([tr("a",cfg(),[
  {"t":0,"op":"key","level":"H","action":"install"},
  D(1,1200,[P("H",0,[{"type":"CRYPTO","offset":2,"data_hex":"0304"}])]),
  D(2,1200,[P("H",1,[{"type":"CRYPTO","offset":0,"data_hex":"0102"}])]),
])]))
print("crypto_reorder", json.dumps(r['results'][0]['crypto']))
# multiple streams sorted + STOP rollback test: packet STOP then error
r=run(req([tr("a",cfg(),[
  {"t":0,"op":"key","level":"A","action":"install"},
  D(1,1200,[P("A",0,[{"type":"STOP_SENDING","id":0},{"type":"STREAM","id":1,"offset":0,"data_hex":"aa","fin":False}])]),
])]))
print("stop_rollback", json.dumps(r['results'][0]['streams']))
# crypto overlap first
r=run(req([tr("a",cfg(overlap="first"),[
  {"t":0,"op":"key","level":"H","action":"install"},
  D(1,1200,[P("H",0,[{"type":"CRYPTO","offset":0,"data_hex":"aa"}])]),

])]))
print("crypto_first", json.dumps(r['results'][0]['crypto']))
